findings.text: follow-on: the fragment and the manifest report name 2's review round as 'persisted as 0.562' (also in the H1 at line 12), but the node's own record computes that round's mean as 0.516667 at shc-midplane-docs-refresh.json review_verdicts name 2 last_round_score (0.425, 0.5625, 0.5625), and no score was persisted at all (review_checks gives reviewer_score_docs null for that name), so the cited figure cannot be reconciled against the record the fragment points a reader to; the below-threshold conclusion is unaffected.

follow-on: _graph_comments() is defined and never called - report() takes its comments from comments() at line 330 reading the captured logs/reviewer-comments.json - and it re-expresses the docs-axis reviewer-feedback read the repository already owns at imas_codex/standard_names/graph_ops.py:2480 (StandardNameReview history) and :2635 (reviewer_comments_docs) without extending either.

follow-on: MIDPLANE_IDENTIFIER_RE is reported only through its empty result - read_checks at line 398 records names_the_midplane_identifier false with midplane_identifier_hits [] for both names (shc-midplane-docs-refresh.json read_checks) - while nothing in the runner demonstrates the regex firing on text known to contain the phrase, so the absence rests on an instrument whose refusal is never shown; the before-state text that does contain it is present in the record as superseded_locus_sentence (run.py:206) but is never run through the pattern.

follow-on: report()'s branch returns 0 unconditionally, and the manifest pairs its 'tests:' line (the consistency command) with test_logs logs/node-gate.log, whose own '# command:' header records the report command instead, so the gate receipt's declared command and its listed log are two different commands; the green run of the declared consistency check (logs/consistency-check.json) carries a '# command:' header and no EXIT= line, and node-gate.log's header names 'base: f43739c65' rather than the revision the gate ran at.
